entities.name: Ebi
entities.description: A kor sentry at the reclaimed Sea Gate on Zendikar, killed by a demon.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: A reclaimed city on Zendikar with a lighthouse where a council is held.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane where Sea Gate lies.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A demon who attacks and strangles Ebi.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind-mage and planeswalker who returns from the Eye of Ugin.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker and Commander-General at Sea Gate who thanks Ebi.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan approaching Sea Gate, trapped by the hedrons.

events.summary: Ebi spots Jace returning from the Eye of Ugin and leads him up to the council room in the lighthouse.
events.quote: Ebi led the mind-mage up the stairs leading to the council room at the top of the lighthouse

events.summary: Ebi reports the perimeter is secure and Gideon thanks him.
events.quote: Ebi reported that the perimeter was secure

events.summary: Ebi watches the forces of Sea Gate trap Ulamog in a circle of hedrons and cheers.
events.quote: He could not help whooping a cheer at the impressive spectacle

events.summary: A demon lands in front of Ebi and strangles him until he dies.
events.quote: the demon squeezed his powerful hands until blackness took him

relations.note: The demon strangles Ebi on his cliffside post.
relations.quote: the demon squeezed his powerful hands until blackness took him

relations.note: Ebi is a sentry; Gideon was counting on him.
